name: Fake Extrude
description: Fakes a solid 3D extrusion by stacking copies of the layer one behind another along the layer's own depth axis. Uses the real 3D position, Z and Rotation X / Y / Z of the layer itself (no linked Null needed) and the scene camera (Effect Camera Matrix patch), so the copies keep their true depth in perspective when the layer or the camera moves. Separate back and front layer counts, depth or per layer gap, start gap for an empty space next to the face, end scale, twist and end offset, side shade, near / far color, end opacity, face options and a flat 2D fallback.
